provider_rights_matrix.disclaimer: This document represents forensic quantitative research analysis and contractual audit of publicly available vendor terms. It does not constitute formal legal counsel.

Tiingo.agreement_name: Tiingo Terms of Use (Section: Data Storage & Derived Products)
Tiingo.exact_language_key_finding: A Starter Plan or Trial Plan does not permit persistent storage of Derived Products, during the plan or after it ends. On a Starter Plan or Trial Plan, you may calculate Derived Products and hold them only transiently in volatile memory... Company does not provide exceptions under this Section for a Starter Plan or a Power Plan. Only a Start-up, Enterprise, or Institutional account may receive an exception...

Massive_Polygon_io.agreement_name: Massive Market Data Terms of Service
Massive_Polygon_io.exact_language_key_finding: Users may not 'Use Market Data for non-display use or to create derivative works (including, without limitation, any index... investment product... settlement value or investment strategy) based on the Market Data unless you are licensed to do so...'

Alpaca.agreement_name: Alpaca Customer Agreement & Market Data Terms (incorporating NYSE/NASDAQ Global Subscriber Agreements)
Alpaca.exact_language_key_finding: Exchange rules strictly govern real-time exchange data feeds. Caching to create independent historical databases without enterprise redistribution agreements violates SRO policies. Brokerage API natively authorizes simulated paper trading.

Interactive_Brokers.agreement_name: IBKR Market Data & Analytics Subscriber Agreement (Form 1564)
Interactive_Brokers.exact_language_key_finding: Automated algorithmic consumption is classified as Non-Display Use under exchange rules and requires explicit non-display declaration. Inactivity or termination mandates immediate data destruction.

owner_decision_status.rationale: Because Massive default terms explicitly prohibit non-display investment strategy generation, and Tiingo Starter prohibits persistent storage of derived products, DEC-02 cannot be unblocked until the owner executes an authorized subscription tier with verified contractual rights.
